caption:
The biggest IPO in history landed this week — Anthropic, the maker of Claude, raised about $81.3 billion at a $1.5 trillion value (AP, Yahoo Finance). And Wall Street still had its worst week in more than a year.

The Nasdaq fell about 5% Friday and is now negative for all of 2026 — a full year of gains gone. The S&P 500 and Dow are both in a correction, the S&P closing at 6,910 (CNBC, CNN, Nov. 20). Nvidia, a top holding in most index funds, fell about 13% in a single day.

Why it's your money: those indexes sit inside most 401(k)s and RRSPs on both sides of the border, so a week like this quietly trims what millions are saving.

My take: when a record-shattering IPO can't steady the market, it shows how much of your retirement account now rides on a handful of AI names.
